name: Fujiwara no Yasuhira
source:
Son of Fujiwara Hidehira, head of the Oshu Fujiwara clan.
He considers the life of his father Hidehira, the head of the Fujiwara clan, to be absolute.
However, in contrast to his father, who welcomes him to Hiraizumi, he casts a cold eye on Shanao, whom he regards as a nuisance.
His honest nature makes him a difficult person to deal with.
